# Internal Budget Reconciliation Report
## A/B Experiment: Social Sharing Feature (JOB-704)

**Date:** 2026-04-02
**Prepared by:** Chen Xiaoyu

### Summary
Experiment ab_experiment_social_share_export exceeded approved budget by ¥6,500 (54.2% overage).

- **Approved Budget:** ¥12,000 (PRD OBSN-8, Section 6.2)
- **Actual Spend:** ¥18,500

- Extended runtime: 14 days vs planned 7 days (scope expansion from boss)
- Data volume spike: 2.8M users vs planned 1.5M users
- Additional compute instances for real-time analytics

### Mitigation Proposal
Option A: Budget top-up of ¥7,000 (includes ¥500 buffer)

**Recommendation:** Option A - critical for Q1 KPI delivery

Requesting approval from Finance & Dev Lead.
